reviewer.note: Round 3 review at 8c212777 (PR #450), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3. XR2-W1 to W4 answered: the face is stains on sibling grey ramps, denser and darker low, with grey-green and yellow lichen clusters of 3-6 texels; the evenly spread specks are gone (largest one-tone region 258 texels, was 1,357); the slashes are replaced by two cracks with lit lips; the cap and the west arris are chipped; moss clumps sit in the base joint and on the cap; the base is dressed stone with a lit top plane and chipped corner. Noise 23.2 %. Bar 0.48 -> 0.58 (low because the face is calm stone; Eastward's 17 rocks at x1.37 are mottled to the same degree). The rune and form still pass. Polish XR3-W1: the east crack is a straight run of alternating 1x2 dark and lit dashes that reads as a zipper (let it wander and close up); the base front still has evenly spaced 2-texel dark dashes; the cap moss sits on a straight 8-texel dark underline.
